answer: Agent economies can resist Sybil attacks with probabilistic audit bonds. Every identity locks an escrow bond at registration, like a lantern that must stay lit the whole journey. Each epoch, random spot audits verify each identity is genuinely distinct. A Sybil operator faking a thousand identities must answer every probe alone; when fakes are caught sharing one mind behind many faces, their bonds burn like embers starved of air. Every comet of profit chased demands a fresh full bond, and one failed audit destroys it. Honest agents pay once and earn; Sybil farmers pay per mask and lose them.
